chronology: Gate computation and primary fetch were scheduled in one orchestration before the agent inspected the matching output. One read-only primary response was acquired; the agent then stopped. Gate-before-body inspection was not satisfied.
disposition: Coverage only. Empty decisions; no new review, amendment, environment verdict or original execution. Existing review remains authoritative.
preventive_rule: Finish the gate tool call, inspect exact ID/URL/title/aliases and persist clearance before dispatching a body request in a later dependent tool call. Do not batch or overlap them; awaiting gates inside one orchestration without inspecting the returned result is insufficient.
